title: Trip Protection Quick Reference: Travel Delay, Missed Connection and Baggage
content:
Trip Protection plans carry travel delay, missed connection and baggage limits that differ by plan. All amounts are in USD; hours are hours of delay.

## Travel delay and missed connection

| Plan | Paid per full day of covered travel delay | Most paid for travel delay per policy | Hours of delay before the delay benefit starts | Most paid for a missed connection |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Trip Protection Essential | 100.00 | 300.00 | 12 | 0.00 |
| Trip Protection Standard | 150.00 | 500.00 | 12 | 250.00 |
| Trip Protection Plus | 200.00 | 800.00 | 6 | 500.00 |
| Trip Protection Premier | 250.00 | 1000.00 | 6 | 1000.00 |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 250.00 | 1000.00 | 6 | 1000.00 |

## Baggage

| Plan | Most paid for lost or damaged baggage | Most paid for essentials during a baggage delay | Hours of baggage delay before the benefit starts |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Trip Protection Essential | 500.00 | 100.00 | 24 |
| Trip Protection Standard | 1000.00 | 200.00 | 24 |
| Trip Protection Plus | 1500.00 | 300.00 | 12 |
| Trip Protection Premier | 2500.00 | 500.00 | 12 |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 2500.00 | 500.00 | 12 |

## Reading across the tables

- The travel delay maximum is a per-policy figure: on Trip Protection Standard, for instance, no more than 500.00 is paid for travel delay on one policy.
- The waiting periods shorten on the higher plans: the delay benefit starts after 12 hours on Trip Protection Essential and Trip Protection Standard and after 6 hours on Trip Protection Plus, Trip Protection Premier and Trip Protection Premier CFAR; the baggage delay benefit starts after 24 hours and 12 hours respectively.
- Trip Cancellation Only shows 0.00 or 0 in every column, and Trip Protection Essential shows 0.00 for a missed connection.
